statement: Every finite connected cubic bipartite simple graph G with |V(G)| <= 16 has bondage number b(G) <= 4.
contribution: An exact exhaustive resolution of the frozen assertion: nauty 2.9.3 generation yields 60 uncoloured isomorphism classes at the possible orders 6, 8, 10, 12, 14, and 16; every class has a recorded four-edge deletion that strictly increases its domination number, and a separate implementation directly reconfirms every certificate by exhaustive vertex-subset enumeration. Together with the cited 18-vertex b=5 example, the result gives the motivated minimum-order corollary within the connected cubic-bipartite simple class.
